raw_text: Election Alert: Deepfake video of Bollywood actor endorsing PM candidate is being mass-forwarded on WhatsApp and Telegram groups in Hindi-speaking states. Multiple fact-checkers have flagged it. The actor's team has issued a denial. This appears to be a coordinated disinformation campaign timed to influence voters before the upcoming phase.
